description: A search field with a list of suggestions: type to filter, then pick one or several items.

clear.title: Clear Button
clear.description: showClear adds a × button to empty the selection.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: multiple + ComboboxChips shows every selected item as a removable chip.

props.items: The full list of selectable items.
props.value: Selected item (controlled). An array when multiple.
props.multiple: Allow selecting more than one item.
props.showTrigger: Show the arrow button that opens the list.
props.showClear: Show a × button to empty the selection.
props.baseUi: Combobox is built on Base UI. Every Base UI Combobox prop can be used — see base-ui.com.
